maya: Morning all — Maya here, starting today! Can someone point me to HubSpot + Dialpad + Gong access? Also need the sales playbook + one-pager collateral for demos. cc @thalia

owen (sales-ops): welcome @maya! I'll kick off HubSpot seat request now. what's your email?

maya: maya@redwood.com

access-bot: New seat request received: hubspot for maya@redwood.com. ETA 2 business days. For faster access, ask @iris-it for a temporary sandbox seat.

iris-it: Hey @maya — I can do Dialpad and Gong right away. Send me your phone number for Dialpad SMS MFA. Also what's your preferred caller ID? (team or personal)

maya: thanks! phone +1-415-555-0199. prefer 'Redwood Sales'

owen (sales-ops): added you to the onboarding flow. HubSpot role = SDR (can access calling). I'll attach the playbook snippet below.

owen (sales-ops): ```Playbook section: 1) call intro script 2) demo triage 3) handoff to AE - use /book in calendar 4) update HubSpot lifecycle stage``` 

thalia (manager): Hi @maya — welcome! Quick ask: can you complete the demo playbook reading and do the roleplay by EOD Friday? Ping me if blocked. :rocket:

maya: on it! Any collaterals I should review first?

owen (sales-ops): Start with 'SDR_quickplay_v2.pdf' in /drive/sales/onboarding and 'pitch-brief.md'. I'll drop links in a thread reply.

owen (sales-ops): link: https://drive.redwood.com/sales/onboarding/SDR_quickplay_v2.pdf

iris-it: Dialpad invite sent. You should get an SMS for MFA. Gong invite will come in the next hour. Let me know when you can take a test call.

maya: got the Dialpad SMS and Gong invite, hopping on test call in 10.

maya: test call done — audio good. thanks everyone! :tada:

thalia (manager): awesome. added you to a shadow session with @leo at 2pm. We'll also schedule a quick hubspot walkthrough after HubSpot seat is active.

owen (sales-ops): noted — I'll expedite hubspot provisioning, should be ready by tomorrow morning. If not, @iris-it can give temporary view access.

maya: huge thanks. tagging this as resolved for now, will re-open if issues. :white_check_mark:
